show_brand.description: Show brand name/handle watermark at bottom. Default: false.

bg_image.description: Background image path (PNG/JPG/WebP). Rendered with configurable opacity behind gradient overlay.

bg_image_opacity.description: Opacity of background image (0.0-1.0). Lower = more subtle.

logo.description: Brand logo path (PNG/SVG). Rendered at bottom-right corner.

bg_overlay_opacity.description: Opacity of the gradient overlay when bg_image is set. 0.0 = photo fully visible, 1.0 = gradient fully covers. Default: 0.7.

text_color.description: Text color for quote/title text as hex (e.g. "#1e1e2e"). Use when the background is light. Default: template dark theme color.

hashtag.description: Hashtag shown near the bottom, rendered with a leading # (pass without the # symbol).
